summary: Risk Assessment V2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/9 pytest cases pass; discovered bug in /api/risk-assessment/stats where highRisks counter INCLUDES Closed assessments (spec: only non-Closed should count). Frontend: dashboard, 12-step wizard, hazard picker, per-hazard live L×S rating, matrix highlight, 8 person cards, 3 sign-off modals, backwards compat redirect, blank-activity toast, save-and-persist flow all verified against darrenhustle300 account on the public URL.

critical.issue: highRisks counts Closed assessments. Repro: create two entries with residual Extreme hazards where one has status='Closed'; stats.highRisks reports 2 instead of 1. Fix in /app/backend/risk_assessment.py line ~284: guard with `if st != 'Closed' and _has_high_residual(r):`

action_items: Fix highRisks stat in /app/backend/risk_assessment.py to skip Closed rows (line 284 area).

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9 pytest cases; 1 legitimate stats bug found)

seed_data_creation: Test-only assessments were created with TEST_ prefix and deleted at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_risk_assessment.py. It creates TEST_-prefixed entries and cleans them up. The one failing case is TestStats.test_stats_counts — asserts highRisks must exclude Closed rows. After E1 patches the guard, re-run just that test.
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/risk_assessment.py the /stats handler branches on `st != 'Closed'` for both active and reviewsDue counters, but the highRisks branch calls `_has_high_residual(r)` without a status check. Repro: POST an entry with status='Closed' plus a hazard L=5 S=5 (residual Extreme) — GET /stats returns highRisks=1 for that entry alone. Fix: wrap the branch with `if st != 'Closed' and _has_high_residual(r):`. Same status check is already correctly applied in collect_risk_assessment_attention().
